difficulty_reason: The author encodes many independently shared secrets in sparse oracle tables with random query keys. Authorized sets give short conditional programs, while compressing the keys queried by a hypothetical shorter program forces an unauthorized set to reconstruct a secret, contradicting privacy. Amortization controls computational-depth error and transfers MMSA approximation hardness.
